sn7.17:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || 2.
sn7.17:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena navakammika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe kammantaṃ kārāpeti || || 3.
sn7.17:1.3: Addasā kho navakammika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam aññatarasmiṃ sāla-rukkhamūle nisinnaṃ pallaṅkam ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā || || 4.
sn7.17:1.5: Ahaṃ kho imasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe kammantaṃ kārāpento ramāmi ||
sn7.17:1.6: ayaṃ samaṇo Gotamo kiṃ kārāpento ramatī ti || || 5.
sn7.17:1.7: Atha kho navakammika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn7.17:4.1: Evaṃ vutte navakammika-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.17:4.2: Abhikkantam bho Gotama || abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama || pa ||
sn7.17:4.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti || || 1.
